description: E-Forme Pilote S3-P2- Haute pénétration photovoltaïque à l’échelle urbaine is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by soda-is.com. Rooftop PV systems in urban areas are very interesting because they do not emit air pollutants nor GHGs during their exploitation, they produce electricity where this electricity is consumed and they add value to unused urban roofs and reduce urban heat island effect. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "e-shape Pilot S3-P2- High photovoltaic penetration at urban scale" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include OGC, Photovoltaic, MINES ParisTech, GHI, Solar radiation, GEO. The listing shows 1 download or service links in OGC:WPS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
